out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at BAR handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at BACK KITCHEN handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC ADDED SOAP DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD DEBRIS IN THE FRONT CONCESSION HANDWASHING SINK; OBSERVED TRASH AND FOOD DEBRIS IN THE BACK KITCHEN HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE SINKS SHOULD BE THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND THAT HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLLY.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF BACK OF CONCESSION ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PLEASE DRAIN AND WASH/RINSE/SANITIZER THE ICE MACHINE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA DISPENSER AT THE THREE-VAT SINK DISPENSING SANITIZER CONCENTRATION TOO HIGH.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE ENSURE THE DISPENSER IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO DISPENSE AT THE PROPER CONCENTRATION. PLEASE TEST SANITIZER CONCENTRATIONS PRIOR TO MAKING THEM AND ADD WATER TO ENSURE IT IS WITHIN THE PROPER RANGE FOR THE TIME-BEING.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A FEW STRIPS FOR THE TIME-BEING. PLEASE PROVIDE PROOF A NEW KIT HAS BEEN OBTAINED AT THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. AMC THEATRES WORLDGATE 9 (Inspection Date: 09/01/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED THE SINK BASINS FOR THE HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE BACK KITCHEN AND THE FRONT CONCESSION AREA IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE CLEAN THESE SINKS PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A Y-SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PLEASE REMOVE THE Y-SPLITTER BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. IF TWO OUTLETS ARE NECESSARY, THE ESTABLISHMENT MAY PURCHASE THE APPROVED SPLITTER. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. PLEASE REMOVE THE PRE-SCRAPE HOSE OR ENSURE IT CAN BE HUNG UP ABOVE THE FLOOD RIM LEVEL AT THE THREE-VAT SINK PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FLOORS IN NEED OF CLEANING AROUND THE GREASE TRAP, THREE-VAT SINK, BACK KITCHEN STORAGE AREA, AND THE BACK OF CONCESSIONS STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THESE AREAS PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: OBSERVED ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PLEASE ENSURE THE ICE MACHINE IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN BACK KITCHEN IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE ENSURE THIS HANDWASHING SINK IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND IS ONLY USED FOR HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER WAS ONSITE DURING INSPECTION. PIC IS IN PROCESS OF OBTAINING CERTIFICATION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION. PIC WILL ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED HOT DOGS AT 54F AND BEEF SLIDERS AT 53F IN TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. PIC WILL ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER AT 52F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED TCS FOODS IN UNIT AND PLACED A WORK ORDER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS WITH TCS FOODS SHOULD MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE NOT STORED IN THIS UNIT UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN PROPER TEMPERATURES.
